name: Crestchem Limited
about: Crestchem Limited manufactures, markets, and exports nutrition-chemical products in India and internationally. Its products include medium chain triglyceride oil fat powders, and medium chain triglyceride oils; spray dried lactose free skimmed milk powders, and pediatric and adult nutritional products; and spray dried water-soluble oil and fat powders, such as high olic sunflower oil, palm oil, coconut oil, dairy cream, and aromatic oil powders on dairy base materials. The company serves nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, clinical nutrition, sports nutrition, infant nutrition, functional foods, and cosmetics and personal care sectors. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
